37.name: The Perfect Nanny
37.overview: Gypsy Willis explains why she moved into Martin MacNeill's home two weeks after his wife's death.

38.name: Unfriended
38.overview: When a couple is found dead, the investigation leads to a woman they had a relationship with online, her family and a man who claimed to work for the CIA.

38.name: After Midnight
38.overview: The murder trial of Tom Fallis, who was accused of killing his wife after her death was originally ruled a suicide.

38.name: Bad Blood
38.overview: Gio Benitez reports on the story of a 29-year-old lawyer who was found shot six times by his girlfriend in what she claims was self-defense, but a former girlfriend enlightens police with information that could possibly indict the current girlfriend.

39.name: Finding Owen: A Boy's Story
39.overview: A report on a child's life with autism.

39.name: Lost at Sea
39.overview: A man found adrift at sea in a life raft claims his mother disappeared when their boat sank during an ill-fated fishing trip the two had embarked on.

40.name: Love at First Sting
40.overview: Authorities set up an elaborate sting operation to catch a Houston couple who were allegedly attempting to hire a hit man to kill their exes.

40.name: Justice for Holly
40.overview: The 2011 disappearance of a 20-year-old Tennessee woman and the ensuing investigation; interviews with the victim's family members and others connected to the case.

40.name: Wonder Boy
40.overview: Following the life of Nathaniel Newman -- who was born with a cranio-facial condition known as Treacher Collins -- and his family.

40.name: A Killing on the Cape
40.overview: An investigation on Christa Worthington's murder in 2002 and the man accused. Christa was stabbed to death with her daughter at her side, and new details on the crime raise questions as to whether the right person was convicted for the murder.

40.name: House of Horrors
40.overview: Thirteen siblings are found captive inside a California home; what life was like inside; details on the alleged abuse.

40.name: Slender Man
40.overview: Interviews with key people connected to the case in which two 12-year-olds stabbed their friend 19 times and left her for dead in an effort to appease the mysterious fictional character known as Slender Man.

40.name: Would You Kill for Love?
40.overview: A man convicted of murder claims new DNA analysis exonerates him of the murder of his former girlfriend's parents; interviews with those close to the case, including the original investigators, and former London detectives who believe he is guilty.

40.name: Toxic Love
40.overview: A man is convicted and sentenced to life in prison for two counts of solicitation of capital murder after he and his veterinarian girlfriend attempted to hire someone to kill their exes.

40.name: My Reality: A Hidden America
40.overview: Sexual harassment in the workplace and potential solutions.

40.name: The Royal Wedding
40.overview: A look at the two most important women in Prince Harry's life, his mother, Princess Diana, and his soon-to-be bride, Meghan Markle.

40.name: Lights, Camera, Christmas: Inside Holiday Movie Classics
40.overview: Peter Billingsley, the star of "A Christmas Story," discusses some of the most memorable and beloved Christmas movies of all time, including interviews with the stars, and behind-the-scenes looks at some of the most memorable moments from the films.

50.name: The Salem Strangler
50.overview: After a young college student is found strangled on the side of the road, the case goes cold until an eerily similar attack breathes new life into the investigation and helps enforcement catch a killer.

50.name: Home Alone
50.overview: Allison Feldman, 31, was working in medical sales when she was found dead in her Scottsdale, Arizona, home in 2015. The crime shocked the community and left detectives with one major question: who could have committed such a violent attack without leaving an obvious connection to the victim?

50.name: Born to Kill
50.overview: Catherine "Cati" Ann Blavatsky, 22, is found dead inside a concrete box in the basement of an abandoned farmhouse. Her estranged husband goes on the run with a 17-year-old, leading authorities on a cross-country chase.

50.name: The Suitcase Murders
50.overview: In June 2014, a highway worker cutting grass discovers two large suitcases with foul odors beside a rural road in Wisconsin. Inside, investigators find the bodies of Jenny Gamez and Laura Simonson, leaving a community shocked and searching for answers.

50.name: Help Dale Find Dee
50.overview: Dee Warner, a successful businesswoman, goes missing without a trace. A deadly mystery. Families bitterly divided. What really happened?

50.name: Justice for Faith
50.overview: Faith Hedgepeth, a college sophomore, is found murdered in her apartment in 2012. Now, with the verdict just in, see exclusive interviews with the jurors, investigators, and friends.

overview:
20/20 is an American television newsmagazine that has been broadcast on ABC since June 6, 1978. Created by ABC News executive Roone Arledge, the show was designed similarly to CBS's 60 Minutes but focuses more on human interest stories than international and political subjects. The program's name derives from the "20/20" measurement of visual acuity.

The hour-long program has been a staple on Friday evenings for much of the time since it moved to that timeslot from Thursdays in September 1987, though special editions of the program occasionally air on other nights.

seasons.overview: The hourlong broadcast includes insightful interviews with notable figures from the worlds of news, politics and entertainment, hosted by David Muir and Amy Robach. A revolving team of journalists from ABC News also contribute investigative stories.

seasons.overview: The hourlong broadcast returns for its 43rd annual installment complete with all-new insightful interviews with notable figures from the worlds of news, politics and entertainment. Hosted by David Muir and Amy Robach, a revolving team of journalists from ABC News also contribute investigative stories. Airs weekly on Friday evenings for two hours at 9|8c on ABC.
